title: For each of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they of
question: For each of the top 10 departments by the number of unique subjects they offered in academic years 2014 or later, list the department name, the count of unique subject titles, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of course materials per subject offered by that department in the term 2017SP, and calculate the ratio of the subject count to the material count range rounded to two decimal places, ordering the results by this ratio in descending order.

prediction.sql:
WITH dept_subjects AS (
  SELECT
    ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
    MAX(ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs
  WHERE ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= '2014'
  GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  ORDER BY subject_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
material_counts AS (
  SELECT
    lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    lso.SUBJECT_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS material_count
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso
  JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm
    ON lso.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
  WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2017SP'
  GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    mc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
    MAX(mc.material_count) - MIN(mc.material_count) AS material_range,
    VARIANCE(mc.material_count) AS material_variance,
    STDDEV(mc.material_count) AS material_stddev
  FROM material_counts mc
  GROUP BY mc.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT
  ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
  ds.subject_count,
  dst.material_range,
  dst.material_variance,
  dst.material_stddev,
  ROUND(ds.subject_count / dst.material_range, 2) AS ratio
FROM dept_subjects ds
JOIN dept_stats dst
  ON ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dst.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
ORDER BY ratio DESC

  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs

  GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  ORDER BY subject_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
material_counts AS (
  SELECT
